heading: Questions, *answered.*

items.question: When are Christmas Eve services at Christ Community Church?
items.answer: Christmas Eve, Thursday, Dec 24, at 2, 4 and 6 PM. There's also a service the night before, Wednesday, Dec 23, at 6 PM. Every service is the same one-hour experience, and all times are Central.

items.question: Where is Christ Community Church?
items.answer: 404 S 108th Ave, Omaha, NE 68154, in west Omaha. It's an easy drive from Millard, Elkhorn, Ralston, La Vista, Papillion, Bellevue and Council Bluffs.

items.question: Do I need tickets?
items.answer: No. Services are free and open to everyone. Pick a time and come. Worship Center doors open 30 minutes before each service, and seats are first-come, first-served.

items.question: Is there childcare?
items.answer: Yes, for kids 3 and under at the Wednesday 6 PM and Thursday 4 PM services. Kids of every age are welcome in every service, and the Wiggle Room in the Atrium carries the service live for little ones who need to move.

items.question: What should I wear?
items.answer: Whatever you're comfortable in. You'll see Christmas sweaters, dresses, suits and jeans.

items.question: Is there an ASL interpreted service?
items.answer: Yes. The Wednesday, Dec 23, 6 PM service is ASL interpreted and live captioned on-site.

items.question: Can I watch Christmas Eve services online?
items.answer: Yes. Every service on Dec 23 and 24 streams live on YouTube and the CCC app, and is available on-demand afterward.

items.question: How long is the service?
items.answer: About one hour, with carols, candlelight, something for every age and the story of the birth of Jesus.
